article.title: Power of Magistrate to direct local investigation and examination of an expert
article.content:
158Power of Magistrate to direct local investigation and examination of an expert

Section 158 · Chapter XI · Public nuisances
The Magistrate may, for the purposes of an inquiry under section 156 or section 157—
(a)direct a local investigation to be made by such person as he thinks fit; or
(b)summon and examine an expert.
